title: Pi-vs-Legacy benchmark run record
description: Contract for a single paired-benchmark run record (one engine arm of one scenario/seed). Authored as task B0-1 of the Pi-vs-Legacy benchmark program (master plan §10). Every downstream asset — runner, feature-criteria compiler, JudgeLayer, and the report generator — validates its output against this schema. One record is emitted per (scenario × seed × engine) run; the two engine arms of a pair share `pair_id`. See comparison-Istara-pi/README.md.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of THIS schema. Records whose major version differs from the report generator's are rejected, not silently pooled.

record_id.description: Globally unique id for this single run record; reruns get a new id and never overwrite prior evidence.

pair_id.description: Shared by the two engine arms (pi + legacy) of the same scenario/seed/fixture pair. A pair with a missing arm is reported, never dropped.

tier.description: Determinism tier (master plan §10.1.2). Mandatory on every record; the report generator asserts no table mixes tiers.

engine.description: Engine under test for this arm. Selected per-call via the dispatcher header x-istara-agent-engine.

pack.description: Scenario pack this record belongs to (master plan §10.3).

order.description: Which arm ran first for this pair, to expose and control order bias.

provenance.description: Immutable run provenance. Endpoint fingerprints MUST be redacted before write (master plan §10.6); raw URLs/tokens/connection strings never reach an artifact.

input_sha256.description: Hash of the byte-identical fixture/input shared by both arms of the pair.

endpoint_fingerprint.description: Redacted, non-identifying fingerprint of the endpoint (never a raw URL, token, or connection string).

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Normalized out before the report reproducibility (byte-identity) check.

status.description: Run outcome. `not_runnable` and `invalid_pair` are counted in every denominator/table, never silently dropped (master plan §10.1.6).

not_runnable_reason.description: Required when status is not_runnable; a machine-readable typed reason.

usage.description: Token/cost accounting (axis 6, master plan §5.5). `estimate` is mandatory: Pi rows are exact from the ledger; legacy rows are provider-reported when available (estimate=false) else estimated (estimate=true). Exact and estimated values are NEVER summed into one column downstream (acceptance A15).

estimate.description: true when any figure in this block is estimated rather than provider-reported/ledger-exact.

estimator.description: Name of the estimator when estimate=true (e.g. the pricing table + heuristic used).

metrics.description: The ten owner axes (master plan §10.2). Each axis block is optional per-record (only packs that exercise an axis populate it) but its shape is defined here so downstream assets extend a shared contract. Axis 6 (tokens/cost) lives in the top-level `usage` block.

feature_integration.description: Axis 2. Per-feature criteria_scores compiled from docs/features/inventory.json. Features whose criteria cannot be auto-derived are counted as `criteria: manual`, never skipped.

criteria.description: `auto` when every criterion is machine-derivable; `manual` when at least one is not (still counted and reported).

output_quality.description: Axis 3. Deterministic checks (reuse scripts/run_istara_evals.py) plus judge rubric 1-7.

spine_phase.description: Axis 4. Per-phase scores over the 10-phase research-validity taxonomy.

memory_load.description: Axis 5. Memory items/tokens per step, retrieval precision@1/recall@3, cross-session recall, worker/backend RSS.

tool_efficiency.description: Axis 7. Efficiency frontier: quality vs tool_calls.

skills.description: Axis 8. Per-skill contract: expected phase, output-schema validity, marker compliance, ordering.

prompt_adherence.description: Axis 9. Protected-block survival, persona-constraint compliance, injection resistance, thinking-leak rate.

a2a.description: Axis 10. Rounds, messages, tool_calls, wall-clock, tokens vs judge-scored quality; dominance analysis.

extensions.description: Forward-compat escape hatch for downstream assets that need record-level fields not yet in this schema. Kept separate so the top level stays a strict contract (additionalProperties:false).

allOf.description: A not_runnable record must carry a typed reason.

feature_criteria_scores.description: Axis 2 per-feature criteria scores (master plan §10.2). Each criterion is a 0..1 score or null when not applicable.

paired_stats.description: Paired comparison statistics (master plan §10.1.5). Populated by the report generator, not the runner. A delta whose bootstrap CI crosses zero is reported as `no detected difference`, never rounded up to a win.

delta.description: Per-scenario paired delta (pi minus legacy) for the axis metric under comparison.

no_detected_difference.description: true when the bootstrap CI crosses zero.
